# Exercises

One pull request per exercise, using the PR template. Ask your review buddy to review within 24 hours.

## Week 1: Foundations

- **Foundations:** Add a clear button to the search box that empties the search model and hides when the box is empty. Files: `src/app/features/products/components/product-filters.ts`
- **Accelerated:** Move the home concept list into a typed concepts.ts file and add a text filter with computed(). Files: `src/app/features/home/home.ts`, `src/app/features/home/home.html`

## Week 2: Signals and components

- **Foundations:** Add a ui-empty-state component to the library and use it in the product list and the cart. Files: `projects/ui-kit/src/lib/`, `src/app/features/products/product-list/`, `src/app/features/cart/`
- **Accelerated:** Build ui-tabs / ui-tab with contentChildren() and use it on the product page. Files: `projects/ui-kit/src/lib/`, `src/app/features/products/product-detail/`

## Week 3: Services, DI, state and routing

- **Foundations:** Create a "Recently viewed" signal store (max 5, persisted) fed by the product page and shown on home. Files: `src/app/core/services/`, `src/app/features/products/product-detail/`, `src/app/features/home/`
- **Accelerated:** Add a wishlist: store, /wishlist route behind authGuard, header badge, toggle on the product card via output(). Files: `src/app/core/services/`, `src/app/app.routes.ts`, `src/app/layout/header.html`

## Week 4: Data and async

- **Foundations:** Add /categories/:slug using router input binding and httpResource, with a retry button on error. Files: `src/app/app.routes.ts`, `src/app/features/products/`
- **Accelerated:** Add a caching interceptor driven by an HttpContextToken and a refresh-token flow using /auth/refresh. Files: `src/app/core/interceptors/`, `src/app/core/services/auth.service.ts`

## Week 5: Forms, pipes, directives, i18n and theming

- **Foundations:** Add a third language and a relativeTime pipe used on reviews. Files: `public/i18n/`, `src/app/core/services/language.service.ts`, `src/app/shared/pipes/`
- **Accelerated:** Rewrite the product editor with Signal Forms and add a fourth brand palette that passes WCAG AA. Files: `src/app/features/admin/product-editor.ts`, `src/styles.css`

## Module: Startup logic and config-driven content

- **Foundations:** Add a back-to-school campaign page using existing section types, scheduled, with a header link in app-config.json. Files: `public/content/pages/`, `public/config/app-config.json`
- **Foundations:** Add a testimonials section type in four steps, with a unit test for its validation. Files: `src/app/features/content/engine/`, `src/app/features/content/sections/`
- **Accelerated:** Add a maintenance mode to the runtime config with a guard and a startup log entry. Files: `src/app/core/config/`, `src/app/core/startup/`, `src/app/app.routes.ts`
- **Accelerated:** Post form sections to an optional submitUrl, show server errors per field, add showWhen conditional fields. Files: `src/app/features/content/`

## Week 6: Quality, performance and the capstone

- **Foundations:** Write unit tests for DiscountPricePipe, LanguageService and ProductCard. Files: `src/app/shared/pipes/`, `src/app/core/services/`, `src/app/features/products/components/`
- **Accelerated:** Test the product list with HttpTestingController and the error interceptor's 401 handling; npm pack the ui-kit and use it in a fresh app. Files: `src/app/features/products/product-list/`, `src/app/core/interceptors/`, `projects/ui-kit/`
- **Both tracks:** Capstone: a Recipes area on DummyJSON – URL-driven list, resolver detail page, favourites store, translations, theme tokens only, at least four unit tests. Files: `src/app/features/`. Demoed at Checkpoint 3.

## Definition of done (every exercise)

- `npm run build` has no warnings and `npm run test:all` passes.
- New user-facing strings are in every translation file.
- Components use semantic theme tokens only.
- The PR description includes your progress summary (Learn page → "Copy progress for your PR").
